newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Profit-taking trims Danubius gains in Budapest mkt.
newsitem.headline: Profit-taking trims Danubius gains in Budapest mkt.

text.p: Hungarian shares closed mixed on the Budapest bourse on Friday in what dealers said was a hectic market.
"Everybody is edgy, as they do not know whether to sell or buy at current, already high prices," said Gabor Borda of Concorde Securities.
Hotelier Danubius, after releasing January-September results, soared to an all-time high of 3,560 forints, but by close it retreated more than it had gained to close at 3,275 forints, down 175.
"It was clearly profit-taking behind it," Borda said, adding that this was true not only for Danubius.
With the end of the year approaching, everybody is looking at closing its portfolio as they had already made their profit, he said, but could not tell whether today's downward trend would continue.
"We will see what happens on Monday," Borda said.
